critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1049 lines; recurring decorator + dashboard summary + report builders are the top three extraction candidates.

_decorate_bills() runs an await _linked_sum() inside a Python for-loop (N+1 against /transactions). For users with many bills, batch this into one aggregate on {user_id, link_type:'bill', month:view_month} and group by link_id.

Dashboard summary computes bills_total using the DECORATED bill amount (same amount per month, correct) but edu_total uses raw items without month filter - edu items are a single catalog so the count is cross-month; that is consistent with 'recurring' semantics but could be documented.
